actual_observation: Expanded SystemUI quick-settings/notification shade covers the display at drag failure, rather than Home/external island.
production_findings: CallIslandView records raw coordinates on DOWN, requests parent noninterception and cancels child before drag on MOVE.
External listener verifies live owned call and saves normalized position only after uncancelled drag with live ownership.
TouchFeedback does not intercept or transform live hit regions.
Same-token presentation changes do conservatively cancel a view gesture, but this does not explain opening SystemUI shade; no such change was proven at the failed pointer.
Ongoing call channel is LOW/nonintrusive; incoming HIGH heads-up is removed around answer asynchronously.
hypothesis_not_proven: A transient nonfocusable SystemUI heads-up/touch region can occlude the top island while launcher is focused and AX overlay bounds are still full. First DOWN may therefore reach SystemUI; its downward drag opens shade. Need native unoccluded-window/predrag evidence.
